nodes.description: Private owner address of EthereumRocket; assigned msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for delegate, init, _mints, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated with raw (+=/-=) arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend instead of SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of ERC20 allowances, read and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress and checked in ensure.
Whitelist mapping(address=>bool) granting sale permission, set true in _mints and read in ensure.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared with _saleNum inside condition.
Minimum sale amount, set in init.
Maximum sale amount, set in init.
Number of allowed sales per address, set in init and consumed by condition.
Constant decimals = 18 used to scale totalSupply and sale limits.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate checking owner, tradeAddress, UNI pair address and canSale before falling back to condition().
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure(), and moves balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner/privileged-address function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale[spender]=true, bypassing sale restrictions.
Owner-only initialiser for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch airdrop that multiplies _value by _tos.length and debits/credits balanceOf in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation helper used by ensure.
Payable constructor naming the token, minting _supply to msg.sender and making msg.sender the owner.
msg.sender - externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance spending, approvals and balance mutation.
a.delegatecall(b) - arbitrary external code executed in the contract storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed with raw arithmetic and no underflow guard.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with raw arithmetic and no overflow guard.
addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in _mints.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
_to argument of transfer(address,uint).
_value argument of transfer(address,uint).
_from argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
_to argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
_value argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint) used for the balance arithmetic.
_spender argument of approve(address,uint).
_value argument of approve(address,uint).
a - target address of the delegatecall.
b - raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
addedValue - amount scaled by 10**decimals and written to balanceOf[spender].
spender - recipient whose balance and canSale flag are set in _mints.
_tos - recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value - per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length.
i - loop counter over the _tos array in batchSend.
